snippet.description:
Diwali is a time to celebrate, reconnect with family, and make memories that stay with us. This festive season, the LevelUp IAS faculty team comes together to share heartfelt wishes with UPSC aspirants and their families. Sonia Ma’am, Vishal Sir, Karandeep Sir, Chandan Sir, Akhilesh Sir, and Santosh Sir have a simple message: don't let preparation stress take away the joy of the festival. Take a short break, spend time with your loved ones, and enjoy the celebrations. And when the festivities are over, return to your preparation with fresh energy. Wishing everyone a safe, happy, and prosperous Diwali!

For Rs.50,000 Scholarship: https://www.levelupias.com/scholarship-test-for-upsc-gs-foundation/

Haven’t started your UPSC preparation yet?
Join our free 10-day bootcamp for UPSC beginners.
https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-aarambh/

🔍Get a FREE 1-to-1 Mentorship Session with real teachers and senior mentors: https://shorturl.at/uBnu0

📲Queries? Call directly: 8826496658

Meet us 📍 at LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
